title: C# Beginner Mock Test 1
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for C# at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes .NET SDK in C#?

options.text: the SDK includes build run and test tools

The runtime automatically repairs invalid state

questions.explanation: the SDK includes build run and test tools. Verify with nullable analysis, compiler diagnostics, and a focused test.
